svg.title: Languages in Alex Földvári's own repositories
svg.desc: Share of code by bytes, as reported by GitHub, across 39 repositories, private included: TypeScript 75.2%, JavaScript 8.6%, PLpgSQL 6.7%, CSS 3.2%, PHP 2.5%, HTML 2.2%, Other 1.5%, each rounded to one decimal. Forks, archived repositories, organization repositories and this profile repository are not counted. The stacked bar grows once from left to right on load, then the card stays still.
